'''Philip Marschall''' (also published as '''Phillip Marshal''')<ref name="dt-21389">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21389 Hidden Stuff], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 12 February 2002).
